title: Pain and Sleep With Aging
subtitle: Evidence, practical strategies, and safety related to pain and sleep with aging.
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports the bidirectional relationship between pain and sleep disturbances in aging and the effectiveness of non-pharmacologic interventions. Moderate evidence guides pharmacologic therapy with caution due to safety concerns. Emerging evidence explores molecular mechanisms and circadian modulation.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
